messages.subject: workflowr 1.7.1
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Version 1.7.1 was recently released to CRAN. This patch release includes improved documentation, bug fixes, and a reduction in the number of Suggested dependencies. Many thanks to Yongqi Wang (@wyq977), Xiongbing Jin (@warmdev),  and Yihui Xie (@ihui) for their contributions!

https://workflowr.io/posts/workflowr-1.7.1/
https://github.com/workflowr/workflowr/releases/tag/v1.7.1
https://cran.r-project.org/package=workflowr

Also, a reminder that if you have a workflowr website you'd like to share more widely, you can add it to workflowr.io <http://workflowr.io> with only a few clicks on GitHub.

https://workflowr.io/
https://workflowr.io/docs/

John
